events.name: Alabama Ballet Presents Swan Lake
events.info: Swan Lake returns as Alabama Ballet celebrates the 150th anniversary of this iconic ballet. Set to Tchaikovsky's unforgettable score, the ballet tells a haunting story of love and betrayal between Prince Siegfried and Odette, a young woman bound by a sorcerer's curse. By night, Odette is human; by day, she is transformed into a swan, living beside a moonlit lake. When Siegfried vows his devotion, hope for her freedom appears within reach. Deception and illusion soon test that promise, placing love and loyalty at risk. Richly atmospheric staging and sweeping choreography bring this timeless tale to life. Rooted in classical tradition, the ballet blends romance, drama, and fantasy. Swan Lake continues to captivate audiences as one of the most enduring works in the ballet repertoire.
events.pleaseNote: If you have celebrated your 2nd birthday, you must have a ticket.

venues.name: BJCC Concert Hall

boxOfficeInfo.openHoursDetail: The BJCC Central Ticket Office is open Monday through Friday 9:00am to 4:00pm CT. The Central Ticket Office is located at Legacy Arena, Entry A, 1898 9th Ave North, Birmingham, AL 35203. The Concert Hall and Theatre Box Office opens two hours before scheduled start time for most events. Hours may vary for some events.
boxOfficeInfo.acceptedPaymentDetail: MC, VISA, AMX, DISCOVER and Cash.
boxOfficeInfo.willCallDetail: Will Call is only available the day of the event at the Concert Hall/Theatre Box Office. For most events, will call opens two hours before the scheduled start time. Hours may vary for some events. Please bring a picture ID, the actual credit card used to purchase the tickets, and your order number.

venues.parkingDetail: Visit www.BJCC.org/plan-your-visit/directions-and-parking for a printable map and to pre-purchase parking. Parking prices vary by event and date. We aim to make navigating the BJCC campus simple using clear directions. With various parking options for events, conventions, and meetings, planning ahead ensures a smoother arrival. Since multiple events often occur simultaneously, arrive early to avoid long parking and entry lines.
venues.accessibleSeatingDetail: Accessible seating is available throughout the venue and can be purchased on Ticketmaster.com. Guests requiring accessible seating are guaranteed the ability to purchase at least one (1) companion seat. Subject to availability, guests requiring wheelchair seating may purchase up to a total of three (3) companion seats in the same row and contiguous with the wheelchair seat. If contiguous seats have already been sold, seats as close as possible to the wheelchair seat and adjacent companion seat will be offered. If you purchased a ticket in the fixed seating area but require an accessible seat, the Ticket Office may be able to assist you by relocating your ticket to an accessible seat. Please contact the Ticket Office at CTO@bjcc.org if you have any questions or require assistance purchasing tickets. Tickets are subject to availability.

generalInfo.generalRule: The following items are not permitted to be brought into the Complex at any time: laser pointers, food or beverages, glass containers, weapons, cameras, audio or video recorders.
